_about: Per-episode style decisions. style_menu.py reads this with the series style_log.json and says which options are blocked by the rotation rules. 'rotate': how many previous episodes an option may not repeat from (0 = no rule). Ask the user every decision for every video.

decisions.question: How should this episode's story be structured?

options.chronological: Tell it in time order, from the event to today.
options.latest_first: Open on the newest development (a report, a ruling, an anniversary), then go back to how it began.
options.one_evidence: Follow one key piece of evidence (the envelope, the radio log, the autopsy) through the whole case.
options.two_accounts: Set the official account against what the evidence shows, chapter by chapter.

options.object: On the object at the centre (the parcel, the plane, the car), before saying why it matters.
options.document: On a close-up of a document: a cable, a report page, a court order, a death certificate.
options.today: On today: where the case stands now, then rewind.
options.witness: On one witness's account, in their reported words.

decisions.question: How long should the narration be?

options.15-20: About 2,200-2,600 words. For a tight case with one main question.
options.25-30: About 3,100-3,700 words. The usual deep dive.
options.30-35: About 3,700-4,300 words. For a case with several inquiries and many people.

decisions.question: Which signature sequence should this episode have?
decisions.hint: Propose 2-3 sequences built only for this story (a timeline of the last 72 hours, a reconstruction of the route, a document dissected line by line, a sound-only radio log). The user can type their own.

options.cork: Cork board. Investigations with many people.
options.blueprint: Navy blueprint. Aviation, engineering, technical mysteries.
options.manila: Light manila case file. Courts, commissions, case files.
options.olive_canvas: Olive canvas. Coups, the military, wars.
options.concrete: Grey concrete. Modern or urban stories.

decisions.question: Which reconstruction style for the key moment?

options.silent_film: Sepia silent film: boiling lines, iris wipes, intertitles. Streets, journeys, arrivals (recon_silent.py).
options.newspaper: Newsprint: invented masthead, headlines setting, halftone photos, red pen marks, page wipes. When the press is part of the story (recon_newspaper.py).
options.courtroom_sketch: Courtroom-artist pastels: hatched figures, benches, witness box, draw-on sweeps. Trials, inquiries, testimony (recon_sketch.py).
options.none: No reconstruction; the board carries the whole episode.

options.geographic: Country outlines from Natural Earth, tinted in the theme (themes.draw_geo_map).
options.sketch: A hand-drawn local sketch map: streets, airport, river, forest, scale bar.
options.transit: A schematic route diagram: straight lines, stations, times, like a metro map.
options.none: No map; the story is not about places.

options.drone: Dark low drone with a soft pulse.
options.piano: Sparse felt-piano notes in a minor key. Grief, memory, a life cut short.
options.pulse: Ticking clock and slow heartbeat. Countdowns, last hours, procedural stories.
options.ambient: Airy wind and a high shimmer. Landscapes, long aftermaths, open questions.

options.elevenlabs_clone: The user's ElevenLabs voice clone. The user generates chapter1.wav... in ElevenLabs and saves them in the episode folder.
options.own_recording: The user records the whole narration.
options.kokoro: Kokoro text-to-speech (am_michael at 0.9 unless told otherwise), generated by Claude.

decisions.question: Should the user open and close the video in their own recorded voice?

options.both: A short intro (under 30 s) and outro in the user's real voice: intro.wav and outro.wav.
options.outro_only: Only the closing perspective is in the user's real voice.

decisions.question: Include the closing 'What the evidence shows' segment?

options.yes: Claude drafts 150-220 words from the sourced facts; the user edits, approves and records it (or generates it with their clone).

decisions.question: Which thumbnail layout for the main thumbnail (the test thumbnail uses a different one)?

options.pinned: Two pinned photos, red string, stamp with the text.
options.split: Photo on the left, huge text on a dark panel, last line red.
options.fullbleed: Full-frame photo, darkened, huge text bottom left over a red bar.
options.casefile: Manila folder, paper-clipped photo, red rubber-stamp text, polaroid.
